verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-configurable background automations, such as scheduled or recurring jobs or autonomous agents that act without a triggering session. The Workflow Management editor only configures conditional checks inside a live, end-user-driven verification session, which is an adjacent feature. Webhooks and Link callbacks are developer building blocks for building automation, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
